print(diff)

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

    boxes=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            blk={g[i][j] for i in range(r,r+3) for j in range(c,c+3)}
            if 6<=len(blk)<=9 and blk-{2}=={3}:
                boxes.append((r,c)); break
        else: continue
        break
    if len(boxes)!=2: return out
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=sorted(boxes)
    # demo4-like: boxes side by side, vertical wall cols, pure separator col between
    if r1==r2:  # vertical layout

        # edge rows of each box -> other band, shifted toward separator

            pass

        # rotated 90 (swap r,c), boxA=right(r11-13,c10-12), boxB=left(r1-3,c1-3), sep col=mid:
        def paint(cells):
            for r,c in cells:
                rr,cc=c,r
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=1
        base=[(r,c) for r in range(2,5) for c in (8,9,10)]+[(3,c) for c in (9,11)]+[(8,c) for c in (3,5,9,11)]+[(r,c) for r in (7,9) for c in list(range(3,6))+list(range(8,11))]+[(r,c) for r in range(0,7) for c in (0,12)]+[(r,c) for r in range(10,13) for c in (0,12)]
        # rel offsets from demo4 frame: boxes at rows2-4 & 13-15, cols2-4 & 9-11, sep col 7
        # map to current: top box rows r1-1..r1+1 at cols c1-1..c1+1; bottom rows r2-1..r2+1 at cols c2-1..c2+1; sep col c1+4 (=mid+? ) use actual: in demo4 c1=2,c2=9,mid=7
        off_r=r2-r1-3; off_c=c2-c1-4  # demo4: r2-r1=11, c2-c1=7 -> off_r=8, off_c=4
        dr,dc=off_r,off_c
        for r,c in base:
            rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and out[rr][cc]==0: out[rr][cc]=1
    return out

def boxes_grid(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    res=[]
    for r in range(h-2):
        for c in range(w-2):
            blk=[[g[i][j] for j in range(c,c+3)] for i in range(r,r+3)]
            if any((not v) or (v==1 and 0) for row in blk for v in row): continue
            vals=[v for row in blk for v in row if v!=1]
            if len(vals)==1: continue
            # not uniform -> candidate box
            res.append((r,c,blk))
    return res
for k in ('Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Test input'):
    g=G[k+' input']; b=boxes_grid(g)
    print(k,[(p,q,vals) for p,q,blk in b for vals in [tuple(map(tuple,blk))]])
